approach.mechanism: Registration with the Home Agent (signed, replay-protected); the Home Agent tunnels (IP-in-IP) packets for the home address to the current care-of address; replies go direct (triangle routing).
approach.name: Basic Mobile IP
approach.recovery_point: first accepted registration reply (the Home Agent now tunnels to the new care-of address)
approach.scope_limits: Break-before-make: the old link disappears with the movement.
approach.status: Educational Mobile IPv4-style demonstration (Stage 4). NOT RFC 5944 compliant: HMAC-SHA256 instead of keyed-MD5, no Foreign Agent, no ARP, no reverse tunnelling (see docs/MOBILE_IP.md).

reason: mip-basic with make-before-break: basic Mobile IP is break-before-make by definition here; use approach 'mip-mbb' for the overlap variant
support: protocol code + byte-accurate IP-in-IP on the emulated network
